answer_1.quote: Among the diverse applications of LLMs, code generation stands out as pivotal task ... We evaluate MPSC on four widely used code generation benchmarks, including HumanEval, HumanEval+, MBPP and CodeContests.

answer_2.quote: The evaluation metric is Pass@k (Chen et al., 2021), which is an unbiased estimator of the probability that at least one out of the k solutions generated by the model passes unit tests.
